notes.title: #stayhome #playlooppy
notes.content:
We, the [b]Cyber ​​Eye[/b] team, in connection with the current situation in the world, strongly recommend that you stay at home until the end of quarantine. We know how difficult it is to give up such ordinary things as shopping, going to restaurants and so on, but still we urge you not to lose heart and use your free time for pleasure and going through our game [b]Adventures of Looppy[/b].

We are also launching a small competition, the essence of which is to go through 17 levels at speed or simply [b]speedrun[/b].
The rules are simple:
- You need to go through [b]17 levels[/b] in less than [b]60 minutes[/b]
- The passage must be recorded on the video and put on YouTube.
- Drop the link to the passage to the mail: events.cybereye@gmail.com

After [b]30 days[/b], we will give away pleasant prizes among those who were able to do this and followed all the rules.

#stayhome #playlooppy

notes.title: You are ready?!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36228092/10173cef8e79a3e0bd4ba81d571f30188ab552b0.jpg[/img]
We are in a hurry to inform you that on March 4, 2020, our game will be released! We thank everyone who added the game to wishlist and shared with friends, as well as all those who managed to play it at the demo stand in Kiev at Games Gathering 2019.

As a competition, we will send pleasant prizes to the first three participants who will be able to complete our game with additional levels in less than 60 minutes!

Conditions of the competition:
- We shoot a video of your speedran and put it on YouTube
- Send a link to the mail: events.cybereye@gmail.com

notes.title: What's new?
notes.content:
Hello everybody! ːSteamhappyː

So what has happened to us since the page was added to steam?

Firstly, we participated in the magnificent conference [b]Games Gathering 2019[/b].
On it we gave everyone to try to go through several levels and get acquainted with the basic mechanics of our game.
We thank all the participants of the [b]Games Gathering 2019[/b] for their interest in our game, adding the game to the wish lists and generally warm atmosphere.

Secondly, we created the game’s page in [url=https://www.facebook.com/The-Adventures-of-Looppy-100860831399111/]Facebook[/url] so you can keep abreast of the latest developments!

Thirdly, bugs were fixed that complicated the life of our little unicorn Looppy ːsteamhappyː

At the moment, we are actively collecting and testing levels, adding hidden locations and nice buns that will help you through the game.

The release date is as we originally planned for February 2020.

Add to the wish lists those who have not done it yet, subscribe to our page on [url=https://www.facebook.com/The-Adventures-of-Looppy-100860831399111/]Facebook[/url] and share our game with friends!

All with the upcoming holidays!

With love,
Cyber ​​Eye Team!
